correctionToV192: The v192 identity gate stated that v102 and v129 were distinct dataset versions and that the identical counts of 61 zero-length loops did not establish edge identity. Thus all 61 zero-length self-loop records in v102 and v129 original-topology-raw.json are the same graph edges by mountain code and zero-based edge index.
